title.zh: 音樂 Transition 概念展示

desc.zh: 在兩段循環之間切換，比較「立即」「下一拍」「下一小節」「淡入淡出」四種轉場策略的時機與聽感。
desc.en: Switch between two loops and compare the timing and feel of four transition strategies: immediate, next beat, next bar, crossfade.

concept_level_note: ADR-004 self-check 2026-08-28: only generic section-switch timing (beat/bar quantisation, crossfade) is shown; patterns are synthesized in-browser; no project code, assets, or gameplay details are reused.
